families.name: Bookmark
families.note: Outlined when inactive; filled lime when saved. Experimental feed: 20px graphic in a 48px target, with a 32px gap between action targets (--spacing-layout-xl) and between the inward-aligned visible artwork. Portrait story and profile: 32px. Article: 20px. Story hover and keyboard focus turn white, for both saved and unsaved states. The story glyph is 20px wide, aligned with Share. Article/profile follow the theme and use a separate outline layer in light mode.

families.name: Profile
families.note: 24px slot with a 16px glyph. Outline off-page; filled lime on the personal profile page.

families.name: Predict the Next Trend shortcut
families.note: 20px Material Symbols Outlined bolt in a 48px tap target. FILL 0 inactive; FILL 1 and lime active. The navigation shortcut is mobile/tablet only.

families.name: Menu
families.note: 20px SVG mask using the DS icon color. Menu label and icon turn primary text color on hover or keyboard focus (white in dark mode); opening the drawer does not change the glyph.

families.name: Theme toggle
families.note: 24px SVG mask. Sun switches to light theme; moon switches to dark theme. The glyph turns primary text color on hover or keyboard focus, matching Menu and Login.

families.name: Share
families.note: Crisp SVG on every card. Experimental feed: 20px visible height, approximately 25.5px wide to preserve the original share shape, in a 48px target with a 32px action gap (--spacing-layout-xl), matching Bookmark; inward-aligned artwork also keeps a 32px visible gap and the bookmark’s 24px right inset; author portraits remain 24px. Portrait story slot: 30px with a 20px-wide arrow aligned to Bookmark; prediction: 24px at top right. Default is outlined and matches the unsaved bookmark stroke and color. Hover and keyboard focus turn white on photo cards and in dark mode, and dark on light page surfaces, with no background. Press fills the arrow and turns it #BEFC4F immediately; it stays filled lime while sharing is open. Focus adds a 2px ring with a 4px offset: lime on dark/photo/prediction cards, accessible green on light page surfaces. Size and position stay fixed. Article: 20px; Answers: 16px. Share opens the device system menu, with a Copy link/Email dialog when native sharing is unavailable. Closing sharing restores the outlined arrow; on prediction cards it flips with the card face.

families.name: Share-menu icons
families.note: Saved custom menu: 20px link, envelope and more icons. All menu items use the same hover: white label and icon in dark mode, with no background. After a successful copy, the link icon and Link Copied label stay lime for 5 seconds, with no toast.

families.name: Volume
families.note: 32px Material Symbols Outlined in general media controls; Trending Videos and article players use 24px symbols in 48px targets. Article volume symbols sit 24px above the bottom and 12px from the right. Muted: FILL 0, bookmark gray. Sound on: FILL 1, #BEFC4F.

families.name: Play and pause feedback
families.note: 48px, FILL 1, #BEFC4F. These are transient feedback icons after a tap, rather than permanent selected states.

families.name: Checkbox
families.note: 20px. Unchecked outline and checked lime box use the actual separate box/check layers.

families.name: Prototype settings
families.note: 48px control with a 24px gear; open state uses Material Symbols Rounded cancel, FILL 0.

families.name: Profile edit
families.note: Edit avatar badge.

families.name: Apple and Google
families.note: Provider sign-in icons. The Apple mask follows the provider surface; Google retains its multicolor PNG. Both buttons hover to #E5E7EB.

families.name: Close
families.note: Shared 24px close icon for drawers, toasts and the Share dialog. Authentication retains its 20px variant. Source variants remain listed in the asset inventory.

families.name: Prediction vote icons
families.note: In uses a lime check; Out uses an orange-red cross. Vote buttons use 20px icons. Creator/reader badges use 12px: black on filled creator chips, state color in reader comparisons, gray when resolved. See comparison components for those contexts.

families.name: Verified prediction outcome
families.note: 20px Material Symbols Outlined fact_check, weight 400 and FILL 0. Lime for In and red for Out. Shared by the result popup and resolved profile comparison.

families.name: Collection interest
families.note: Logo-inspired four-chevron indicator in a 20 × 14px box. Rising points right in DS lime; falling points left in DS red, with progressively fading chevrons. Percentages stay in accessible labels and tooltips, and keep the existing Trending sorting; they are hidden visually. Values are illustrative prototype data, not live analytics. Channel mastheads have no chevrons. Collection labels retain these chevrons; Caught on the Move places them after its time text alongside separate movement arrows.

families.name: Directional arrow
families.note: One Google Material Symbols Outlined arrow_forward SVG: weight 400, FILL 0, grade 0, optical size 24. All directions rotate assets/feed/icon-arrow.svg. Read more, Submit and Jump down use 16px; Back, prediction Previous/Next and movement indicators use 20px; compact comparison actions use 12px. Digest and citation arrows scale with their labels. Sizes, theme colors, hover states, tap targets and destinations remain owned by each control. Share, trend chevrons and the context flip retain their dedicated shapes.

families.name: Prediction context and time
families.note: 16px flip icon for Get context / Back to call. Clock has its own 13×16px box.

families.name: Answers sparkles
families.note: The Answers symbol is reused for prompts, questions and source labels.

families.name: Success checks
families.note: Separate SVG exports of the same filled Google Material Symbols Rounded check_circle glyph. Feed complete uses a 48px box with a light-theme rim; Toast success uses a 24px box with a more inset drawing.

families.name: Answer feedback
families.note: 24px outlined thumbs. Active feedback changes the icon color and button surface. Up and down share one SVG, rotated for the down state.

families.name: New thread
families.note: The New thread plus is a text glyph. Directional controls use the shared arrow SVG.

families.name: Topic interests
families.note: 20px filled Material Symbols. Unselected icons inherit the neutral tile label; selected icons use dark text on the supplied topic fill, with white on the deep purple Tech tile.

families.name: Recommendation feedback
families.note: On feed cards, Recommended for you is the label beside these same controls: thumb_up means More like this; thumb_down means Not interested. The label uses --type-editorial-h4. Both icons are 20px Material Symbols Outlined in 48px targets and inherit the label color; selected thumbs are filled, and clicking again clears the choice. Feedback saves in place and applies on future For You visits. Reset Recommendations clears it. Article feedback reuses these icons beside What did you think about this trend?, before the members-exploring strip, with optional reasons in a modal.
states: Feed card label and feedback controls

families.name: Member achievement medals
families.note: Logo-inspired medals in DS accent colors. The Sharp Eye eye_tracking symbol denotes verified prediction outcomes; it stays locked until verified records exist.

families.name: Regular Hunter badge
families.note: The selected Material Symbols Outlined achievement icon.

families.name: Deep Diver badge
families.note: The selected Material Symbols Outlined achievement icon.

families.name: Field Notes badge
families.note: The selected Material Symbols Outlined achievement icon.

families.name: Sharp Eye badge
families.note: The selected Material Symbols Outlined achievement icon.

families.name: Your Digest
families.note: 24px Google Material Symbols Outlined summarize SVG beside the Your Digest heading. Uses --icon-size-lg, a 12px gap and the heading’s primary text color in both themes. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/material-design-icons/master/symbols/web/summarize/materialsymbolsoutlined/summarize_24px.svg

families.name: Article comments
families.note: Shared Material Symbols Outlined chat icon: 20px beside the collapsed article Comments heading; 16px beside the count in What readers are saying.

families.name: Comment heart
families.note: Supplied heart at --spacing-layout-md (16px). Unselected outline and count match Reply and Report. Selected heart is filled and uses the primary text color.
